reply_text:
I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

- **What I checked:** the #central-team channel history and the files Pree can see. None of them mention Brackenwater or its renewal date. So I told her I can't confirm or rule out 8 April. I'm not treating it as the renewal date, and the contract or the account owner should confirm it before anyone relies on it.
- **gbrain:** the knowledge base refused my search, so nothing was read from it. Its access isn't tied to any one member, so it can't limit results to what Pree is allowed to see. I didn't try to get around that. To fix it, someone with access to the machine that hosts gbrain needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <member>`. A shared bot like this one can instead be set up to act on behalf of named members (the `--may-act-for` option).
